question: GQ-001
subject: the endpoint I verified did not exist in the running service
the_first_lesson: I tested /search on a scratch port, saw six correct responses, and wrote a worklog. The LIVE service still returned 404 — the running process predated my edit. A verified endpoint that is not deployed is not a feature.

what_i_found_restarting_it.two_servers: com.siso.librarian-observatory runs python3 -m http.server on 8845; com.siso.observatory runs serve-observatory.mjs on 8765. Both serve public/. I had assumed one.
what_i_found_restarting_it.consequence: my endpoint went into the Node one, which is real but was not the server I first inspected

three_wrong_diagnoses_before_the_right_o.disproved: WorkingDirectory is set correctly in the plist

three_wrong_diagnoses_before_the_right_o.guess: bare 'node' is not on launchd's PATH
three_wrong_diagnoses_before_the_right_o.disproved: true (env -i finds nothing) but NOT the cause — the CLI runs fine with no PATH at all. Fixed anyway with process.execPath, which is correct regardless.

three_wrong_diagnoses_before_the_right_o.guess: the rebuild holds a write lock
three_wrong_diagnoses_before_the_right_o.partly_true: it did, and the CLI died at its startup schema check — fixed with sqlite .timeout 5000, verified working DURING the rebuild in 2s. Still not the endpoint failure.

the_actual_cause.error: unable to open database ... authorization denied
the_actual_cause.not_permissions: the file is -rw-r--r-- owned by the same user, and the CLI reads it fine from a terminal
the_actual_cause.what_it_is: macOS TCC withholds removable-volume access from processes launchd starts
the_actual_cause.who_can_fix_it: Full Disk Access in System Settings — a GUI action, and Shaan's to take

what_i_did_instead: the endpoint now answers 503 with the diagnosis AND the exact remedy, rather than a generic "search failed". A permission wall that reads as "search is broken" is the kind of thing nobody fixes, because nobody knows what to fix.

verified.live_endpoint: HTTP 503 naming TCC and the fix
